sahneler.metin: A nuclear submarine sank during a deep-diving test.
It fell past its crush depth, and all one hundred twenty nine aboard were lost.
Investigators believe a pipe joint leaked in the engine room.
The reactor shut down, and the sub lost power.
The crew tried an emergency blow of the ballast tanks.
Ice formed in the air system and blocked it.
Without that air, Thresher kept sinking.
The Navy then created the SUBSAFE programme.
